title: sideritis hirsuta subsp. hirtula
intro: Sideritis hirsuta subsp. hirtula, commonly known as Mountain tea or Greek mountain tea, is a species of flowering plant in the mint family, native to the mountainous regions of the Balkan Peninsula. This plant has been traditionally used to treat various health issues due to its numerous health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Sideritis hirsuta subsp. hirtula include its ability to soothe digestive issues, reduce fever, and alleviate respiratory problems. The bioactive constituents responsible for its therapeutic effects include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and diterpenes, which are known to possess anti-inflammatory and antioxidant activities.
